title: Pure Cupid
summary: Cupid is a sports-themed LIGHT Fairy Level-modulation series built around the 600 DEF statline and featuring Cupid Volley, Cupid Serve, Cupid Dunk, Cupid Fore, and the Synchro Tuner Cupid Pitch. By swarming the field with 600 DEF monsters like The Agent of Creation - Venus and Cupid Fore, and dynamically adjusting Levels with Cupid Volley, Cupid Serve, and Cupid Fore, the deck climbs through multi-tiered Synchro and Xyz plays while using Cupid Pitch to search any Level 8 or lower monster with 600 DEF.

allow.Diviner of the Herald: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner that pairs directly with a Level 2 Fairy or sends a Level 1 Fairy to the GY to pair with Cupid Volley for Level 4 Cupid Pitch.
allow.The Agent of Creation - Venus: Level 3 LIGHT Fairy with 600 DEF (searchable by Cupid Pitch) that summons up to 3 Mystical Shine Balls to enable Cupid Fore, Rank 2 Xyz, and Cupid Pitch plays.
allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster with 600 DEF summoned by Venus to immediately Synchro Summon Level 4 Cupid Pitch alongside Diviner or Martial Metal Marcher.
allow.Hop Ear Squadron: Level 2 WIND Beast Tuner with 600 DEF (searchable by Cupid Pitch) that Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn using Cupid Pitch or your Main Deck Fairies.
allow.Creation Resonator: Level 3 Tuner with 600 DEF searchable by Cupid Pitch that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 8+ Synchro.
allow.Herald of Pure Light: Rank 2 LIGHT Fairy Xyz made with Mystical Shine Balls that detaches 1 material to recover a monster from the GY.
allow.Martial Metal Marcher: Level 3 Synchro Tuner companion that revives a Tuner from the GY and treats a Synchro Summoned monster as a Tuner.
allow.Old Entity Hastorr: Level 4 WIND Synchro that equips to an opponent's monster when sent from the Monster Zone to the GY to negate its effects and later take control of it.

main: Level 6 LIGHT Fairy (600 DEF) that Special Summons itself from the hand while you only control 600 DEF monsters and discards 1 card as a Quick Effect to make a LIGHT Fairy's Level match another face-up monster's Level.
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy (600 DEF) that cannot be destroyed by battle except by a monster with a higher Level and increases its Level by 1 during your Standby Phase.
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy (600 DEF) that is unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with a higher Level and banishes up to 3 cards from your GY to increase its Level by that amount.
Level 1 LIGHT Fairy (600 DEF) that sends up to 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the GY to increase its Level by that amount and gains 1500 LP if destroyed by card effect.
Has 1600 ATK / 600 DEF (directly searchable by Cupid Pitch) and summons 3 Level 2 Mystical Shine Balls for Synchro and Xyz plays.
Level 2 Fairy (600 DEF) used with a Level 2 Tuner to Synchro Summon Cupid Pitch or overlay into Rank 2 Xyz.
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner that pairs with Cupid Volley, Cupid Serve, or Mystical Shine Ball to Synchro Summon Cupid Pitch.
600 DEF Tuner searched by Cupid Pitch when used as Synchro Material, allowing an instant Quick-Synchro on the opponent's turn.
600 DEF Level 3 Tuner searched by Cupid Pitch that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 8 or higher Synchro Monster.
extra: Signature Level 4 Synchro Tuner (600 DEF) that increases or decreases its Level by the Tuner's Level, burns on Synchro Summon, and searches any Level 8 or lower monster with 600 DEF when sent to the GY as Synchro Material.
Rank 2 LIGHT Fairy Xyz made with Mystical Shine Balls that detaches 1 material to recover a monster from the GY.
Level 3 Synchro Tuner companion that revives a Tuner from the GY and treats a Synchro Summoned monster as a Tuner.
Level 4 Synchro that equips to an opposing monster to negate its effects when sent to the GY and takes control of it if Hastorr leaves the field.
